name: Troll
body:
Source Pathfinder RPG Bestiary pg. 268
 This family represents a group of similar monsters. No official description was provided.
Members
Canopy Troll (CR 3), Chimney Troll (CR 2), Flood Troll (CR 2), Ice Troll (CR 4), Jotund Troll (CR 15), Moss Troll (CR 3), Mountain Troll (CR 14), Rock Troll (CR 6), Sewer Troll (CR 2), Troll (CR 5), Troll Acolyte (CR 6), Troll Berserker (CR 9), Troll Brute (CR 7), Troll Elder Matron (CR 10), Troll Fury (CR 8), Troll Monarch (CR 15), Troll Render (CR 10), Troll Ripper (CR 8), Troll Warden (CR 6)
